name: Takeda Yoshinori
source: A first-year student who joined the auditing committee. He sees things in black and white and tends to overlook emotional factors, making him seem like a robot to others. However, he is highly respectful of giving people what they deserve. Compared to Komatsu, he’s even more committed to his job and doesn’t feel stressed about doing what it demands of him.
